values: Cyclic self-sumset recognition: a credited corollary of the integer hardness theorem. Accepted scope: Same-group ordinary cyclic self-sumset recognition is NP-complete in both explicit sparse binary and dense bit-vector encodings, already odd n, target zero-anchor and representatives <n/2. Limits: No gap asserted for exact decision languages; unrestricted meanings of efficient, unconditional P!=NP, randomized/approximation/oracle claims excluded. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness remain unestablished. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; 2 fresh complete AI package reviews, latest zero actionable issues; no conventional human peer review or formal certification.
